title: AADP Evidence Module v1.0 — Claim
description: Top-level module document kind `claim`: the value of an AADP v1.0 entity's `x_evidence` field, on an entity with `type: "claim"` (specification.md §4). Nested inside an already-versioned entity, so it self-describes `module`/`version`/`kind` but not `aadp_version`. Like Answer `1.0`, the Evidence wrapper has NO `x_*` extension point (specification.md §5) — the Relations extension point on `evidence_refs[].target` is unaffected. Code-point bounds after trimming, the duplicate-target rule and `content_checksum` are pure semantic rules, not expressible here.
